svg.aria-label: The Core-owned planning driver get_kv_cache_configs. It calls the platform's builder for two decisions: grouping and placement. Grouping resolves to the platform override, then the model hook, then the default heuristic. Core checks every grouping. Future work: the worker also reports which layers belong to the drafter.
svg.text: One planning driver, two pluggable decisions
get_kv_cache_configs runs once in EngineCore at startup; profiling uses the same builder. Gold = future work.
num_blocks=1 probe gives bytes per block
